description: Multiple customers successfully purchased the same SKU despite stock reaching zero, resulting in unfulfillable orders.
labels: logs: ERROR [InventoryService] - OptimisticLockException on SKU_9932: version mismatch
root_cause: Database transaction isolation level set to READ COMMITTED instead of SERIALIZABLE during high-concurrency checkout flow.

description: Orders remain in 'Pending Payment' status even though customers' cards were successfully charged by Stripe.
labels: logs: WARN [StripeWebhookController] - Signature verification failed for payload id evt_3L9x...
root_cause: The webhook endpoint secret was rotated in the payment gateway but not updated in the production middleware environment variables.

description: Checkout process stalls for 15 seconds before failing with a generic error when calculating state taxes.
labels: logs: ERROR [TaxClient] - SocketTimeoutException: Read timed out after 15000ms calling https://api.taxprovider.com/v2/calc
root_cause: External tax provider experienced an outage, and the middleware lacked a circuit breaker or fallback static tax rate mechanism.

summary: Loyalty points not deducting on purchase
description: Customers can apply loyalty points to their order total, but the points are not subtracted from their account balance post-purchase.
labels: logs: INFO [OrderProcessor] - Emitting Kafka event OrderCreated. WARN [LoyaltyConsumer] - Message deserialization failed
root_cause: Schema registry mismatch in the Kafka message payload; the Loyalty service failed to parse the 'points_applied' field due to a type change from int to float.

summary: Fraud detection false positives on international orders
description: Legitimate cross-border transactions are automatically declined and flagged as fraudulent.
labels: logs: INFO [FraudEngine] - Transaction blocked. Risk Score: 95. Reason: IP mismatch with billing country
root_cause: The fraud rules engine was updated to heavily penalize VPN usage, but it incorrectly categorized standard European ISP routing as proxy networks.

summary: Cart abandonment emails sent to converted users
description: Users who successfully completed their purchase are receiving automated 'You left something behind' emails.
labels: logs: DEBUG [Cron-CartAbandon] - Processing cart id C_8834. Status: ACTIVE
root_cause: The checkout completion microservice failed to update the cart state from 'ACTIVE' to 'CONVERTED' in the Redis cache due to an asynchronous race condition.

description: Backend warehouse staff are unable to mark orders as 'Shipped' due to system lockups.
labels: logs: FATAL [DBPool] - ERROR: deadlock detected. Detail: Process 1421 waits for ShareLock on transaction 3892; blocked by process 1422.
root_cause: Bidirectional locking between the 'Order_Lines' and 'Inventory_Ledger' tables caused by batch-update jobs running concurrently with manual warehouse updates.

description: Prices converted from USD to EUR are consistently 10% lower than the actual exchange rate.
labels: logs: INFO [CurrencyService] - Fetching exchange rates from Redis cache. Age: 172800s
root_cause: The daily CRON job responsible for fetching updated forex rates from the European Central Bank API has been failing silently for 48 hours.

description: The application server crashes out of memory approximately every 4 hours during peak traffic.
labels: logs: FATAL [NodeProcess] - JavaScript heap out of memory. Allocation failed - process out of memory
root_cause: The PDF generation library (Puppeteer) is spawning headless Chrome instances for each receipt but failing to close the browser contexts after the stream ends.

summary: Missing shipping methods for PO Boxes
description: Customers entering PO Box addresses are presented with 'No shipping methods available'.
labels: logs: WARN [ShippingRouter] - Discarding method FedEx_Ground: restricted address type PO_BOX
root_cause: USPS was accidentally removed from the active courier list in the admin panel, leaving no valid fallback for restricted address types.

summary: Session hijacking via predictable JWT tokens
description: Security audit revealed that user sessions can be hijacked by guessing the session token.
labels: logs: WARN [AuthFilter] - Multiple concurrent IPs detected for session u_773
root_cause: The JWT signing algorithm was accidentally downgraded to HS256 with a weak, hardcoded secret ('test_secret_123') left over from a staging deployment.

description: Selecting a premium color/size variant on the product page does not update the displayed price.
labels: logs: ERROR [Frontend] - Uncaught TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'price_modifier')
root_cause: The GraphQL query fetching product details did not request the 'price_modifier' field for nested variant objects.

description: Transactions initiated via Apple Pay on iOS devices fail at the final authorization step.
labels: logs: ERROR [ApplePayHandler] - Failed to decrypt payment token: Invalid PKCS7 padding
root_cause: The merchant identity certificate used to decrypt the Apple Pay payload expired and was not renewed in the AWS Key Management Service.

description: Customers are able to apply multiple mutually exclusive promo codes, resulting in negative order totals.
labels: logs: INFO [Checkout] - Order total calculated as -12.50. Adjusting to 0.00.
root_cause: The promotional rules engine evaluated discounts iteratively rather than checking the 'exclusive' boolean flag on the coupon entities.

description: Products marked as 'Inactive' in the backend are still appearing in search results and can be added to the cart.
labels: logs: ERROR [ESIndexer] - Bulk indexing failed: MapperParsingException [failed to parse field [price] of type [float]]
root_cause: A recent data migration introduced string characters into a float field, causing the entire ElasticSearch indexing queue to halt.

description: Guest users attempting to checkout with an email already associated with a registered account are stuck in an infinite redirect loop.
labels: logs: DEBUG [AuthRouter] - User exists. Redirecting to /login. Next: /checkout/guest
root_cause: The authentication middleware forces a login redirect for known emails, but the guest checkout controller intercepts the redirect, causing a loop.

summary: Rate limit exceeded on shipping provider API
description: All checkouts are failing with 'Shipping unavailable' during the first 10 minutes of a marketing campaign.
labels: logs: ERROR [ShippoClient] - HTTP 429 Too Many Requests. Retry-After: 60s
root_cause: The backend aggressively queries the shipping API on every keystroke in the zip code field instead of debouncing the requests.

description: Customer support agents clicking the 'Refund' button multiple times trigger multiple identical refunds.
labels: logs: WARN [PaymentService] - Issuing refund of $45.00 against ch_12345 (Attempt 2)
root_cause: The admin dashboard lacks a disabled state on the refund button during API processing, and the backend lacks an idempotency key for refund requests.

description: The iOS app is unable to complete checkout; server returns a 400 Bad Request.
labels: logs: ERROR [ApiGateway] - JSON parse error: Cannot deserialize value of type `java.util.UUID` from String ""
root_cause: The latest iOS app release sends an empty string instead of a null value for the optional 'gift_card_id' field.

summary: Redis cache stampede on homepage products
description: Database CPU spikes to 100% every hour on the hour, causing site-wide latency.
labels: logs: WARN [CacheManager] - Cache miss for key: homepage_featured_products
root_cause: All featured product cache keys have the exact same TTL (3600s) without jitter, causing them to expire simultaneously and triggering a thundering herd on the database.

description: Monthly subscription renewals are failing for a subset of users, leading to unintended service cancellations.
labels: logs: ERROR [SubscriptionWorker] - Charge failed for sub_8832: HTTP 400 'customer_not_found'
root_cause: A recent database cleanup script accidentally purged legacy customer payment tokens from the Stripe mapping table.

description: Users attempting to add more than 50 items to their wishlist encounter a generic server error instead of a friendly warning.
labels: logs: ERROR [WishlistController] - DataIntegrityViolationException: value too long for type character varying(255)
root_cause: The wishlist item array is serialized as a string in the database column, which exceeds its varchar limit when containing more than 50 product UUIDs.

summary: Address validation blocking valid rural addresses
description: Customers in specific rural postal codes are unable to bypass the 'Invalid Address' error during checkout.
labels: logs: WARN [AddressValidator] - SmartyStreets API returned 'no_match' for address_id 99231
root_cause: The address validation middleware is set to 'strict' mode, which rejects addresses lacking standard street numbers, ignoring the 'override' flag passed by the frontend.

description: Customers submitting long product reviews with images experience a timeout, and the review is lost.
labels: logs: ERROR [Nginx] - 504 Gateway Time-out while reading response header from upstream
root_cause: The third-party profanity and image moderation API takes longer than the 30-second Nginx proxy timeout limit to process image payloads.

summary: Gift card double spend race condition
description: A user successfully applied a $50 gift card to two separate orders by opening two browser tabs and checking out simultaneously.
labels: logs: INFO [LedgerService] - Deducting $50 from GC_1029. Current balance: $50. (TxId: 991, TxId: 992)
root_cause: The gift card redemption logic uses a non-atomic read-modify-write operation without optimistic locking, allowing concurrent transactions to read the same initial balance.

description: Wholesale customers adding quantities greater than 1,000 of a single SKU cause the shopping cart service to crash.
labels: logs: FATAL [CartService] - StackOverflowError in calculateTieredPricing() recursive loop
root_cause: The pricing engine uses a poorly optimized recursive function to calculate volume discounts, exceeding the JVM stack size limit on massive quantities.

summary: Multi-currency order value mismatch in BI tools
description: The analytics dashboard reports heavily inflated revenue metrics due to mixed currency aggregation.
labels: logs: WARN [ETL-Pipeline] - Ignored field 'currency_code' during BigQuery ingest for table 'sales_daily'
root_cause: The Kafka connector sinking order events to the data warehouse maps the 'total_price' field as a float but drops the 'currency' metadata, treating JPY as USD.

summary: SSO login failure for returning customers
description: Users who originally signed up with email/password cannot log in using Google SSO, even if the email matches.
labels: logs: ERROR [OAuthHandler] - AccountConflictException: identity provider mismatch for user@example.com
root_cause: The identity management service lacks account linking functionality; it throws a hard error instead of prompting the user to link their Google account to their existing profile.

summary: Free shipping threshold miscalculated with tax
description: Customers receive free shipping when their post-tax total exceeds $100, instead of the required pre-tax subtotal.
labels: logs: DEBUG [PromotionEngine] - Evaluating FreeShippingRule. Target: order.total_amount
root_cause: The shipping promotion rule evaluates against the 'grand_total' object field rather than the 'subtotal' field in the cart payload.

description: Customers purchasing digital software keys are unable to download the installer via the provided email link.
labels: logs: ERROR [S3Presigner] - AccessDenied: The AWS Access Key Id you provided does not exist in our records.
root_cause: The IAM role attached to the service generating S3 pre-signed URLs was accidentally deleted during a Terraform state refresh.

description: Verified wholesale accounts are being charged sales tax despite having valid tax exemption certificates on file.
labels: logs: INFO [TaxProvider] - Customer cert_status=EXPIRED for entity B2B_9918
root_cause: The daily cron job syncing approved tax exemption certificates from the ERP to the e-commerce backend failed silently, defaulting all users to taxable.

description: Security scan identified a reflected XSS vulnerability when typing HTML payloads into the search bar.
labels: logs: WARN [WAF] - Blocked request containing potential XSS payload in query parameter 'q'
root_cause: The frontend React application uses 'dangerouslySetInnerHTML' to highlight search term matches without properly sanitizing the user input.

description: Customers initiating a return in the portal are stuck on a loading screen indefinitely.
labels: logs: ERROR [EasyPostClient] - ReadTimeout exception fetching label for RMA_00329
root_cause: The carrier (UPS) API is experiencing degraded performance, and the frontend lacks a timeout/fallback UI to email the label asynchronously.

description: Users who opted into 'Notify me when available' emails received 50 identical emails in one minute.
labels: logs: INFO [Notifier] - Triggering restock alert for SKU_881. Recipients: 1200
root_cause: A warehouse receiving clerk rapidly scanned the same barcode 50 times to update inventory, triggering the restock event listener on every individual increment.

summary: Invoice PDF formatting broken for long addresses
description: The layout of printable PDF receipts breaks across multiple pages when the customer has a lengthy address or company name.
labels: logs: WARN [PDFGenerator] - Overset text in bounding box 'BillingAddress'
root_cause: The wkhtmltopdf HTML template uses fixed-height CSS containers instead of flexbox or auto-height, causing text overflow to push table elements out of alignment.

description: Mobile web users experience browser crashes after scrolling through multiple pages of the 'All Products' category.
labels: logs: ERROR [ClientTelemetry] - Event: Browser Crash, Reason: OOM, Page: /category/all
root_cause: The frontend infinite scroll component appends DOM nodes indefinitely without using a virtualized list to unmount off-screen product cards.

description: Store credit is applied to the order but not deducted from the cart total if a discount code is also active.
labels: logs: INFO [CheckoutPipeline] - Discount active. Bypassing wallet decrement step for cart_919
root_cause: The checkout pipeline middleware has a mutually exclusive conditional block that skips store credit deduction logic if a promotional coupon code is detected.

description: Guest users clicking 'Track Order' from their email are prompted to log in, but they don't have an account.
labels: logs: WARN [AuthGuard] - Unauthorized access attempt to /order/status/ORD_1092. Missing Bearer token.
root_cause: The order tracking endpoint was mistakenly moved under the authenticated API route group during a recent routing refactor.

description: During weekends, the estimated delivery date on the product page occasionally shows a date in the past.
labels: logs: DEBUG [ShippingCalculator] - ETA calculated as Friday, offset -1 days from current.
root_cause: The delivery calculation algorithm hardcodes a 3-day transit time but incorrectly subtracts days when the transit window overlaps with Sunday.

summary: Session token invalidated on unrelated device logout
description: Logging out of the mobile app simultaneously logs the user out of their active desktop web session.
labels: logs: INFO [SessionManager] - Revoking all tokens for user u_1992
root_cause: The logout API endpoint deletes the entire user session record in Redis instead of just deleting the specific device's JWT family.

description: Orders paid partially with a gift card and partially with a credit card fail during the final capture phase, leaving funds authorized but not settled.
labels: logs: ERROR [PaymentOrchestrator] - Transaction aborted: Partial capture mismatch. Expected $120.00, Captured $70.00 from GC_441.
root_cause: The payment middleware attempts to capture the credit card authorization before verifying the gift card balance lock, resulting in a rollback when the gift card API times out.

description: Customers can purchase promotional bundles even when one of the underlying component products is entirely out of stock.
labels: logs: WARN [InventoryService] - Oversell detected on BNDL_HOLIDAY: Component SKU_99X stock is 0, but bundle stock shows 50.
root_cause: Bundle inventory is cached as a static integer upon creation rather than dynamically calculating available quantity based on the minimum stock level of its child SKUs.

summary: Refunds to expired cards fail silently
description: Customer service agents process refunds, but the funds are never returned to customers whose original payment method has since expired.
labels: logs: ERROR [StripeGateway] - Refund failed for ch_9921: card_declined. Extended code: expired_card
root_cause: The backend does not catch the 'expired_card' exception from the payment gateway to trigger a fallback manual payout workflow, leaving the refund state stuck in 'Processing'.

description: Orders totaling $0.00 (via 100% discount codes) bypass the fraud engine and are automatically fulfilled.
labels: logs: INFO [OrderPipeline] - Order total is 0.00. Skipping Riskified fraud evaluation.
root_cause: The legacy checkout logic has a hardcoded optimization to skip fraud checks for free orders, which is now being exploited using leaked promotional codes.

summary: Guest to registered cart merge drops items
description: When a guest user with items in their cart registers for a new account during checkout, their cart is suddenly emptied.
labels: logs: DEBUG [CartMerger] - Overwriting anonymous cart session anonymous_881 with new user cart u_9912 (empty).
root_cause: The authentication controller instantiates a fresh cart for newly registered users and performs a destructive overwrite instead of merging the existing anonymous cart session.

description: High volumes of shipping updates from the 3PL provider cause database timeouts for customers trying to view their order history.
labels: logs: FATAL [HikariCP] - Connection is not available, request timed out after 30000ms. Pool stats: active=100, idle=0.
root_cause: The 3PL webhook handler opens a database transaction but makes a synchronous external API call to an SMS provider before committing, exhausting the database connection pool.

description: Discount codes specifically configured to exclude 'Clearance' items are successfully discounting clearance merchandise.
labels: logs: INFO [PromoEngine] - Applying 20% discount to cart_772. Exclusions: [CAT_CLEARANCE]. Match found: false.
root_cause: The category hierarchy was restructured, and clearance items are now nested under parent categories. The promotion engine only checks immediate parent categories for exclusions.

description: Orders remain in a 'Pending Auth' state indefinitely if the user closes the browser tab during the bank's 3D Secure OTP verification.
labels: logs: WARN [ThreeDSecureCallback] - Orphaned transaction tx_8812. No callback received from issuing bank within 15 minutes.
root_cause: The system lacks a reconciliation cron job to query the payment gateway for abandoned 3DS challenges, failing to transition the order to 'Failed' and release reserved inventory.

description: Customers with more than 10 past orders see the exact same 10 orders on page 2 of their account history.
labels: logs: DEBUG [OrderController] - Executing query: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE user_id = ? ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10 OFFSET 0
root_cause: The frontend passes the 'page' query parameter as a string, which the backend integer parser fails to cast correctly, causing the offset to silently default to 0.

summary: Abandoned cart emails show internal SKUs
description: Customers are receiving marketing emails that say 'You left SKU_109283_BLK behind!' instead of the actual product name.
labels: logs: WARN [KlaviyoSync] - Missing localized_name for product entity. Defaulting to sku_id.
root_cause: The daily product catalog sync to the email marketing platform fails to map the 'title' field from the newly implemented GraphQL PIM (Product Information Management) schema.

summary: Valid TLDs rejected in email field
description: Users with newer email domain extensions (like .shop, .online, .tech) are blocked from creating accounts.
labels: logs: WARN [RegistrationValidator] - Rejected email format: user@mystore.online
root_cause: The frontend regex used for email validation is severely outdated and restricts the top-level domain (TLD) to a hardcoded list of legacy 2-4 character extensions.

summary: Buy Again button adds discontinued items
description: Clicking 'Buy Again' from order history adds inactive products to the cart, leading to a crash at checkout.
labels: logs: ERROR [CheckoutValidation] - NullPointerException: Cannot invoke getPrice() on null product reference prod_xx1.
root_cause: The 'Buy Again' feature clones the historical order line item directly into the active cart without validating current catalog availability or active status flags.

summary: Session timeout clears cart but retains UI state
description: Users who leave the site open for hours click 'Checkout' and see a blank page, despite the cart icon showing items.
labels: logs: INFO [Gateway] - HTTP 401 Unauthorized for /api/cart/checkout. Session expired.
root_cause: The backend JWT token expires after 2 hours, but the frontend single-page application (SPA) does not intercept the 401 response to clear local state and prompt a re-login.

description: Product Detail Pages (PDP) randomly display a white screen of death due to a frontend crash in the 'You might also like' section.
labels: logs: ERROR [ReactErrorBoundary] - TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'image_url')
root_cause: The AI recommendation API occasionally returns products that lack a primary image array, and the frontend component lacks safe-navigation operators (?.) when rendering the thumbnail.

summary: Store locator returning results in ocean
description: Users searching for nearby physical stores by ZIP code see locations plotted at coordinates 0,0 off the coast of Africa.
labels: logs: WARN [GeoLocator] - Google Maps API quota exceeded. Falling back to default coordinates [0.0, 0.0].
root_cause: The billing credit card for the Google Maps Geocoding API expired, causing all new address-to-coordinate lookups to fail and return the unhandled default.

summary: Apple Pay button missing on Safari
description: The quick-checkout Apple Pay button does not render for Safari users on iOS 17 devices.
labels: logs: DEBUG [PaymentRequestAPI] - canMakePayment() returned false for merchant identifier.
root_cause: A recent Content Security Policy (CSP) update accidentally blocked the Apple Pay domain validation script from executing on the storefront.

description: B2B customers uploading PDF tax exemption documents receive an ambiguous 'Server Error' message.
labels: logs: ERROR [FileUploadService] - RequestRejectedException: The request was rejected because its size (15420112) exceeds the configured maximum (10485760)
root_cause: The Tomcat web server has a default maximum file upload size of 10MB, which is being exceeded by high-resolution scanned PDF documents.

summary: VAT calculation error on UK orders
description: Orders shipping from the EU to the UK post-Brexit are applying EU VAT rates instead of zero-rating the export.
labels: logs: INFO [TaxCalculator] - Applying standard rate 20% for origin DE, destination GB.
root_cause: The tax rules matrix was not updated to reflect the UK's departure from the EU VAT zone; the system still categorizes 'GB' as an intra-community supply.

summary: Customer address deletion cascades to past orders
description: When a user deletes an old shipping address from their profile, all their historical orders lose their shipping information.
labels: logs: WARN [OrderService] - Fetching order ORD_9912. Address relation is null.

root_cause: The database schema uses a hard foreign key with 'ON DELETE SET NULL' linking historical orders to the user's active address book, rather than storing a snapshot of the address at checkout time.

summary: IPv6 addresses blocked by fraud rules
description: Customers accessing the store via cellular networks (mostly IPv6) are consistently flagged as high-risk and blocked.
labels: logs: INFO [FraudEngine] - Order blocked. Rule triggered: Invalid IP Format or Anonymizer.
root_cause: The legacy GeoIP routing library used by the fraud service only supports IPv4 parsing; it fails to resolve IPv6 strings and defaults to a 'High Risk / Unknown Origin' score.
